parts.text: Summarize my journal entries for June 2024.
In June 2024, you moved to Portland. You noted that your new apartment is small but has good light. You also found a coffee shop called 'The Grind' which you loved.
What were the main events and challenges in November 2024?

In November 2024, you received your first paid commission from the Blue Gallery. However, you also faced a financial challenge when your car broke down, costing $500 to repair. You mentioned eating ramen for the rest of the month to save money.
How did I feel about starting school in August 2024?
School started in August 2024. You met Jen in your drawing class, but you found Professor Chen to be intimidating.
